summary.text: David Soucy is a Republican state representative from the Washington-Orange District who was appointed by Governor Phil Scott on April 9, 2026, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He has worked as the general manager of the Green Mountain National Golf Course.

paragraphs.text: David Soucy's professional experience includes working as tournament manager for the New England Professional Golfers Association and as general manager of the Green Mountain National Golf Course.

He has served on the Barre Town Selectboard and has been affiliated with the Judicial Nominating Board, the District 5 Act 250 Environmental Commission and the Mental Health Crisis Response Commission.
Governor Phil Scott, a Republican, appointed Soucy to the Washington-Orange District seat on April 9, 2026, to replace Francis McFaun, and his current term ends on January 4, 2027.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
